name: Skipavillon Lawens
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Skipavillon Lawens in Tirol!**

Experience the thrill of skiing and enjoy the stunning Alpine scenery at **Lawens** near **Innsbruck**. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, our modern ski lifts and well-groomed slopes offer something for everyone.

After an exciting day on the slopes, warm up with a delicious **Kaiserschmarrn** or a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl** at our cozy mountain huts. Savor traditional **Tiroler Speckknödel** or indulge in a creamy **Apfelstrudel** while taking in the breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps**.

In the evening, relax with a glass of local **Apfelwein** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** at our lively après-ski bar. The Skipavillon Lawens is your perfect base for unforgettable adventures in the heart of **Tirol**!
